0022600121.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-1 and 8th in the East, visit the Boston Celtics, who are also 1-1 and 7th in the East, with a 1-0 home record. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston beat Chicago 124-105 in their last meeting, on February 11, 2026 in Boston, as the Bulls lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
